test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MISTAKE' is written as 'LHRUBLF' and 'PROBLEM' is written as 'OQNCMFN'. How will 'STRANGE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed here is:​

'MISTAKE' is written as 'LHRUBLF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f24ba554a81cbcb9166a80d5ae3fa7a08c3aca3a30ae3d87eceab14fbaeb4fe.png] 

And,

'PROBLEM' is written as 'OQNCMFN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5e1550f6d909ae74236e7e81cf9730d8196defedc436b5194641ea7bca0b76d.png] 

Similarly,

'STRANGE' be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc35b8a06aa2fad7f91e036a6412d5f65f3a92e339172f9773199cb60baff54.png] 

Hence, ' STRANGE' is coded as '**RSQBOHF**'
